parts: Write a post about not becoming bitter and resentful, but chosing to live life and turn pain into purpose. Not dwelling on negative and just living my true authentic self which is kind and loving and caring and trusting and no one can take that from me or tell me that I need to be mean or hurtful towards others or those who caused the pain

Here’s a draft you could use for your post:  

---

I’ve made a choice—pain will not turn me bitter, resentful, or cold. Life is too short to dwell on the negative or let hurt define me. Instead, I choose to turn pain into purpose.  

My authentic self is kind, loving, caring, and trusting—and no one can take that from me. No amount of betrayal or heartbreak can force me to be mean, spiteful, or cruel in return. That’s not who I am.  

I believe in breaking cycles, not repeating them. I believe in creating safe spaces, not adding more hurt to the world. I believe in healing, not harming.  

Hurt may shape me, but it will never harden me. I choose love. Always. ❤️  

---
